A straightforward note

Your privacy.

Project enquiries

The enquiry form prepares an email draft on your device. It does not submit information to a form service or save your details in this website. If you choose to send the email, your email provider delivers it to info@revolio.in.

Browsing this site

This website does not add advertising trackers, analytics scripts, or browser storage. Our hosting provider may process technical information needed to serve and secure the site, including sign-in information for private access.

External services

Instagram, YouTube, and Substack links open those services in another tab. Their own privacy terms apply. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts when you load a page.

Contact

For questions about information you share with Revolio, email info@revolio.in.
